name: code-quality-dev
description: [DEV] Production code quality plugin for implementation, refactoring, testing, dependency decisions, and risk-focused code review.

interface.shortDescription: [DEV] Write, refactor, test, and review production code with risk-focused quality judgment.
interface.longDescription: [DEV] Provides a code-quality skill for production implementation, bug fixes, refactoring, testing, dependency and reuse decisions, architecture tradeoffs, and risk-focused code review. It emphasizes correctness, repository context, appropriate reuse, simple coherent design, validation, and avoiding speculative abstractions or unnecessary dependencies.
defaultPrompt: Use $code-quality-dev:code-quality for production implementation, bug fixes, refactoring, testing, dependency decisions, architecture tradeoffs, and risk-focused code review.

Before adding implementations or dependencies, inspect repository modules, framework and system APIs, standard libraries, installed dependencies, and existing utilities; reuse only when meaning, contract, ownership, lifecycle, and long-term cost fit.

Do not apply this plugin to prose-only writing, translation, generated or vendor code edits, formatting-only, style-only, or naming-only changes unless the user explicitly invokes code-quality or asks for correctness, security, compatibility, behavior-change, data-integrity, or operational-risk review.
